# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_STRUCTURE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Around midday (after 11:30 EST), a lower high followed by a break of its low on elevated volume signals a short‑term intraday reversal. The edge exists because intraday momentum often exhausts after the morning push, creating a choppy, mean‑reverting window where a failed higher‑high structure precedes a short‑sell opportunity.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** After 11:30 EST, identify a swing high (HH) then a lower high (LH) where the LH candle closes below the prior swing low. When price breaks below the low of the LH candle on a bar with volume > 1.3 × the average volume of the last 20 bars, enter short at the close of that breakout bar.  
**Exit:** Primary stop at the recent swing high (the HH) or a 1% ATR trailing stop, whichever is tighter; profit target at 1.5R (risk‑reward).  
**Regime filter:** Only take trades when VIX > 18 and the EMA ribbon is flat (|EMA8‑EMA55|/EMA55 < 0.05%); avoid during strong trending periods (ribbon slope > 0.10% per bar).
